title: Localizing Lying in Llama: Understanding Instructed Dishonesty on True-False Questions Through Prompting, Probing, and Patching
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability to localize the internal activations responsible for 'dishonesty' (lying) in LLMs. While honesty is an ethical concept, the paper's experiments involve factual true-false questions about cities, inventions, and chemicals rather than evaluating moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious values.
